title: Plan final timing qualification across the device matrix
requires: Accepted F9 scene repairs, F9-07 Windows timing evidence and the F8 exit performance-debt inventory
scope: After the F8 integration exit and initial F9 scene repairs, inventory every deferred per-device timing target and timing-contaminated negative-control result. Define a fresh candidate freeze, bounded per-device optimization/requalification leaves and a final 60 Hz performance exit review. This bounded investigation/planning task carries performance obligations forward from F8 without granting unmeasured qualification.
acceptance: Map every F8 timing miss or unqualified timing-dependent negative control to its original device, workload, mode, threshold, source and retained evidence. Cover Windows CUDA/D3D12, Linux CPU/CUDA/Vulkan, macOS Metal, iOS Metal and Android as applicable.

Publish bounded new task cards for remaining optimization, a fresh exact-source candidate freeze, required physical device/workload requalification and a final performance exit review. Assign machine requirements, exclusive shared-area locks and an acyclic dependency graph.

Require the final performance exit to wait for every required device/workload row and passing canonical negative controls. Retain frozen counts, sample sizes, every stall and wait, original per-tier latency/rate targets and independent physical/work/recovery checks.

Retain earlier candidate identities, raw failures and completed task history. Define separate integration, physical-quality and final timing verdicts. Only later passing exact-candidate evidence can establish broad 60 Hz qualification.
